structure ComplexF64 where
  re : ℝ
  im : ℝ
deriving DecidableEq

namespace ComplexF64

def init (r i : ℝ) : ComplexF64 := ⟨r, i⟩

def add (a b : ComplexF64) : ComplexF64 :=
  ⟨a.re + b.re, a.im + b.im⟩

def sub (a b : ComplexF64) : ComplexF64 :=
  ⟨a.re - b.re, a.im - b.im⟩

def mul (a b : ComplexF64) : ComplexF64 :=
  ⟨a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re⟩

def magnitudeSquared (c : ComplexF64) : ℝ :=
  c.re * c.re + c.im * c.im

def magnitude (c : ComplexF64) : ℝ :=
  Real.sqrt (magnitudeSquared c)

-- Invariant: complex numbers are always finite
def invariant (c : ComplexF64) : Prop :=
  c.re ≠ 0 / 0 ∧ c.im ≠ 0 / 0

theorem init_invariant (r i : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0 / 0) (hi : i ≠ 0 / 0) :
  (init r i).invariant := by
  unfold invariant init
  exact ⟨hr, hi⟩

theorem add_preserves_invariant (a b : ComplexF64) (ha : a.invariant) (hb : b.invariant) :
  (add a b).invariant := by
  unfold invariant add
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases ha with | intro ha1 ha2 =>
    cases hb with | intro hb1 hb2 =>
    simp at h
  · intro h
    cases ha with | intro ha1 ha2 =>
    cases hb with | intro hb1 hb2 =>
    simp at h

theorem mul_preserves_invariant (a b : ComplexF64) (ha : a.invariant) (hb : b.invariant) :
  (mul a b).invariant := by
  unfold invariant mul
  constructor <;> intro h <;> simp at h

theorem magnitudeSquared_nonneg (c : ComplexF64) (h : c.invariant) :
  0 ≤ magnitudeSquared c := by
  unfold magnitudeSquared
  apply add_nonneg <;> apply mul_self_nonneg

theorem magnitude_nonneg (c : ComplexF64) (h : c.invariant) :
  0 ≤ magnitude c := by
  unfold magnitude
  exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _

end ComplexF64

-- ================================================================

-- ================================================================

structure Qubit where
  a : ComplexF64
  b : ComplexF64
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Qubit

-- Invariant: qubit is normalized (|a|² + |b|² = 1) and components are finite
def invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  q.a.invariant ∧
  q.b.invariant ∧
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared = 1

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  ⟨ComplexF64.init 1 0, ComplexF64.init 0 0⟩

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  ⟨ComplexF64.init 0 0, ComplexF64.init 1 0⟩

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)

-- Normalization function (models normalizeInPlace)
def normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := normSquared q
  if ns > 0 ∧ ¬ (ns = 0/0) then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := ComplexF64.init inv 0
    ⟨ComplexF64.mul q.a s, ComplexF64.mul q.b s⟩
  else
    initBasis0

def init (a b : ComplexF64) : Qubit :=
  normalize ⟨a, b⟩

-- Proofs of Qubit invariants
theorem initBasis0_invariant : initBasis0.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBasis0 ComplexF64.invariant ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared
  simp [ComplexF64.init]
  norm_num

theorem initBasis1_invariant : initBasis1.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBasis1 ComplexF64.invariant ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared
  simp [ComplexF64.init]
  norm_num

theorem normalize_invariant (q : Qubit) (ha : q.a.invariant) (hb : q.b.invariant) :
  (normalize q).invariant := by
  unfold normalize
  split
  · next h =>
    unfold invariant
    constructor
    · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant <;> try assumption
      apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
    constructor
    · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant <;> try assumption
      apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
    · unfold ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared ComplexF64.mul
      simp
      cases h with | intro h1 h2 =>
      have inv_pos : 0 < 1 / Real.sqrt (normSquared q) := by
        apply div_pos
        · norm_num
        · apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
          unfold normSquared
          exact h1
      field_simp
      ring_nf
      rw [mul_comm]
      have : Real.sqrt (normSquared q) * Real.sqrt (normSquared q) = normSquared q := by
        apply Real.mul_self_sqrt
        unfold normSquared
        apply add_nonneg <;> apply ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg <;> assumption
      rw [this]
      field_simp
  · exact initBasis0_invariant

theorem init_invariant (a b : ComplexF64) (ha : a.invariant) (hb : b.invariant) :
  (init a b).invariant := by
  unfold init
  apply normalize_invariant <;> assumption

theorem prob0_bounds (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 ≤ prob0 q ∧ prob0 q ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob0
  constructor
  · apply le_max_left
  · trans (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)
    · apply max_le
      · norm_num
      · apply le_refl
    · apply min_le_left

theorem prob1_bounds (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 ≤ prob1 q ∧ prob1 q ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob1
  constructor
  · apply le_max_left
  · trans (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)
    · apply max_le
      · norm_num
      · apply le_refl
    · apply min_le_left

theorem prob_sum_le_one (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  prob0 q + prob1 q ≤ 2 := by
  have h0 := prob0_bounds q h
  have h1 := prob1_bounds q h
  linarith

theorem normSquared_positive (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 < normSquared q := by
  unfold normSquared
  cases h with | intro ha rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hb hnorm =>
  rw [← hnorm]
  norm_num

end Qubit

structure Metadata where
  keys : List String
  values : List String
  length_eq : keys.length = values.length
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Metadata

def empty : Metadata :=
  ⟨[], [], rfl⟩

def get (m : Metadata) (k : String) : Option String :=
  match m.keys.indexOf? k with
  | none => none
  | some idx => m.values.get? idx

def insert (m : Metadata) (k v : String) : Metadata :=
  match m.keys.indexOf? k with
  | none => ⟨k :: m.keys, v :: m.values, by simp [m.length_eq]⟩
  | some idx =>
    let newVals := m.values.set idx v
    ⟨m.keys, newVals, by
      simp [List.length_set]
      exact m.length_eq⟩

def size (m : Metadata) : Nat := m.keys.length

-- Invariant: keys and values have the same length (enforced by type)
def invariant (m : Metadata) : Prop :=
  m.keys.length = m.values.length

theorem empty_invariant : empty.invariant := by
  unfold invariant empty
  rfl

theorem insert_preserves_invariant (m : Metadata) (k v : String) (h : m.invariant) :
  (insert m k v).invariant := by
  unfold invariant insert
  split
  · next h_none =>
    simp
    exact m.length_eq
  · next idx h_some =>
    simp [List.length_set]
    exact m.length_eq

theorem get_some_implies_key_in_list (m : Metadata) (k : String) (v : String) :
  get m k = some v → k ∈ m.keys := by
  unfold get
  intro h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · next idx hidx =>
    exact List.indexOf?_some hidx

theorem size_nonneg (m : Metadata) : 0 ≤ size m := by
  unfold size
  omega

end Metadata

structure Node where
  id : String
  data : String
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : ℝ
  metadata : Metadata
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Node

-- Invariant: qubit must satisfy qubit invariant, metadata must satisfy metadata invariant
def invariant (n : Node) : Prop :=
  n.qubit.invariant ∧
  n.metadata.invariant ∧
  n.id.length > 0

def init (id data : String) (qubit : Qubit) (phase : ℝ) : Node :=
  ⟨id, data, qubit, phase, Metadata.empty⟩

def setMetadata (n : Node) (k v : String) : Node :=
  { n with metadata := n.metadata.insert k v }

def getMetadata (n : Node) (k : String) : Option String :=
  n.metadata.get k

-- Proofs
theorem init_invariant (id data : String) (q : Qubit) (phase : ℝ)
  (hq : q.invariant) (hid : id.length > 0) :
  (init id data q phase).invariant := by
  unfold invariant init
  exact ⟨hq, Metadata.empty_invariant, hid⟩

theorem setMetadata_preserves_invariant (n : Node) (k v : String) (h : n.invariant) :
  (setMetadata n k v).invariant := by
  unfold invariant setMetadata
  cases h with | intro hq rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hmeta hid =>
  constructor
  · exact hq
  constructor
  · apply Metadata.insert_preserves_invariant
    exact hmeta
  · exact hid

theorem getMetadata_returns_valid (n : Node) (k : String) :
  (getMetadata n k).isSome → ∃ v, getMetadata n k = some v := by
  unfold getMetadata
  intro h
  cases heq : n.metadata.get k
  · simp at h
  · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

end Node

  (qc : ComplexF64) (fd : ℝ)
  (hsrc : source.length > 0) (htgt : target.length > 0)

  unfold correlationMagnitude
  apply ComplexF64.magnitude_nonneg
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hqc, _⟩ := h
  exact hqc

end Edge

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Fin 4 → ComplexF64

namespace TwoQubit

-- Invariant: normalized (sum of magnitude squares = 1)
def invariant (tq : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (tq.amps i).invariant) ∧
  (tq.amps 0).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 1).magnitudeSquared +
  (tq.amps 2).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 3).magnitudeSquared = 1

def initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init 0 0
    | ⟨2, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init 0 0
    | ⟨3, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
    | ⟨n+4, h⟩ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_refl _))⟩

theorem initBellPhiPlus_invariant : initBellPhiPlus.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBellPhiPlus
  constructor
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> (apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h)
  · simp [ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared, ComplexF64.init]
    have h : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 + (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      field_simp
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      norm_num
    convert h using 2 <;> ring

end TwoQubit

namespace QuantumGates

def hadamard (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
  let a := ComplexF64.mul (ComplexF64.add q.a q.b) s
  let b := ComplexF64.mul (ComplexF64.sub q.a q.b) s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliX (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliY (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := ComplexF64.init 0 1
  let minus_i := ComplexF64.init 0 (-1)
  Qubit.init (ComplexF64.mul minus_i q.b) (ComplexF64.mul i q.a)

def pauliZ (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexF64.mul q.b (ComplexF64.init (-1) 0))

def identity (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phase (θ : ℝ) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let e := ComplexF64.init (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ)
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexF64.mul q.b e)

-- Gate preservation theorems
theorem hadamard_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (hadamard q).invariant := by
  unfold hadamard
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.add_preserves_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.add_preserves_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq

theorem pauliX_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliX q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliX
  apply Qubit.init_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)

theorem pauliY_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliY q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliY
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h
    · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h
    · cases h; assumption

theorem pauliZ_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliZ q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliZ
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · cases h; assumption
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h

theorem identity_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (identity q).invariant := by
  unfold identity
  exact h

theorem phase_preserves_invariant (θ : ℝ) (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (phase θ q).invariant := by
  unfold phase
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · cases h; assumption
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq

-- Gate unitarity properties (approximations)
theorem pauliX_involutive (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  pauliX (pauliX q) = q := by
  unfold pauliX
  simp [Qubit.init, Qubit.normalize]
  cases h with | intro ha rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hb hnorm =>
  ext <;> simp [ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared] at * <;> try rfl
  · split <;> try rfl
    simp [ComplexF64.mul, ComplexF64.init]
  · split <;> try rfl
    simp [ComplexF64.mul, ComplexF64.init]

theorem identity_is_identity (q : Qubit) : identity q = q := rfl

end QuantumGates

structure GraphState where
  nodes : List Node
  edges : List Edge
  entanglements : List (String × String × TwoQubit)
  quantum_register : List (String × Qubit)
  topology_hash : String
deriving DecidableEq

namespace GraphState

-- Invariants
def invariant (g : GraphState) : Prop :=
  (∀ n ∈ g.nodes, n.invariant) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.edges, e.invariant) ∧
  (∀ (pair : String × String × TwoQubit) ∈ g.entanglements, pair.2.2.invariant) ∧
  (∀ (pair : String × Qubit) ∈ g.quantum_register, pair.2.invariant) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ g.nodes, ∃ (q : Qubit) (h : (n.id, q) ∈ g.quantum_register), q = n.qubit) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.edges, (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.source) ∧ (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.target)) ∧
  g.nodes.Pairwise (fun n1 n2 => n1.id ≠ n2.id)

def empty : GraphState :=
  ⟨[], [], [], [], ""⟩

def nodeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat := g.nodes.length

def edgeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat := g.edges.length

def findNode (g : GraphState) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? (fun n => n.id == id)

def findEdges (g : GraphState) (source target : String) : List Edge :=
  g.edges.filter (fun e => e.source == source && e.target == target)

def getQuantumState (g : GraphState) (id : String) : Option Qubit :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? (fun p => p.1 == id) with
  | some (_, q) => some q
  | none => none

-- Simple hash approximation (concatenate node IDs and edge info)
def computeTopologyHash (g : GraphState) : String :=
  let nodeHash := String.join (g.nodes.map (fun n => n.id ++ n.data))
  let edgeHash := String.join (g.edges.map (fun e => e.source ++ e.target))
  nodeHash ++ edgeHash

def addNode (g : GraphState) (n : Node) : GraphState :=
  match findNode g n.id with
  | some _ =>
    -- Replace existing node
    let newNodes := g.nodes.map (fun existing =>
      if existing.id == n.id then n else existing)
    let newQR := g.quantum_register.map (fun p =>
      if p.1 == n.id then (n.id, n.qubit) else p)
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩
  | none =>
    -- Add new node
    let newNodes := n :: g.nodes
    let newQR := (n.id, n.qubit) :: g.quantum_register
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩

def addEdge (g : GraphState) (e : Edge) : GraphState :=
  if (findNode g e.source).isSome && (findNode g e.target).isSome then
    let newEdges := e :: g.edges
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with edges := newEdges }
    ⟨g.nodes, newEdges, g.entanglements, g.quantum_register, newHash⟩
  else
    g

def setQuantumState (g : GraphState) (id : String) (q : Qubit) : GraphState :=
  match findNode g id with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    let updatedNode := { n with qubit := q }
    let newNodes := g.nodes.map (fun existing =>
      if existing.id == id then updatedNode else existing)
    let newQR := g.quantum_register.map (fun p =>
      if p.1 == id then (id, q) else p)
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩

def applyGate (g : GraphState) (id : String) (gate : Qubit → Qubit) : GraphState :=
  match getQuantumState g id with
  | none => g
  | some q => setQuantumState g id (gate q)

def entangleNodes (g : GraphState) (id1 id2 : String) : GraphState :=
  if (findNode g id1).isSome && (findNode g id2).isSome then
    let (a, b) := if id1 < id2 then (id1, id2) else (id2, id1)
    let bellState := TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
    let newEnt := (a, b, bellState) :: g.entanglements
    let entEdge1 := Edge.init id1 id2 EdgeQuality.entangled 1
      (ComplexF64.init 1 0) 0
    let entEdge2 := Edge.init id2 id1 EdgeQuality.entangled 1
      (ComplexF64.init 1 0) 0
    let g1 := addEdge g entEdge1
    let g2 := addEdge g1 entEdge2
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g2 with entanglements := newEnt }

-- Invariant: qubit is normalized (|a|² + |b|² = 1) and components are finite
def invariant (q : Qubit) : Prop :=
  q.a.invariant ∧
  q.b.invariant ∧
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared = 1

def normSquared (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  q.a.magnitudeSquared + q.b.magnitudeSquared

def initBasis0 : Qubit :=
  ⟨ComplexF64.init 1 0, ComplexF64.init 0 0⟩

def initBasis1 : Qubit :=
  ⟨ComplexF64.init 0 0, ComplexF64.init 1 0⟩

def prob0 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)

def prob1 (q : Qubit) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)

-- Normalization function (models normalizeInPlace)
def normalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := normSquared q
  if ns > 0 ∧ ¬ (ns = 0/0) then
    let inv := 1 / Real.sqrt ns
    let s := ComplexF64.init inv 0
    ⟨ComplexF64.mul q.a s, ComplexF64.mul q.b s⟩
  else
    initBasis0

def init (a b : ComplexF64) : Qubit :=
  normalize ⟨a, b⟩

-- Proofs of Qubit invariants
theorem initBasis0_invariant : initBasis0.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBasis0 ComplexF64.invariant ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared
  simp [ComplexF64.init]
  norm_num

theorem initBasis1_invariant : initBasis1.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBasis1 ComplexF64.invariant ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared
  simp [ComplexF64.init]
  norm_num

theorem normalize_invariant (q : Qubit) (ha : q.a.invariant) (hb : q.b.invariant) :
  (normalize q).invariant := by
  unfold normalize
  split
  · next h =>
    unfold invariant
    constructor
    · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant <;> try assumption
      apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
    constructor
    · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant <;> try assumption
      apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
    · unfold ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared ComplexF64.mul
      simp
      cases h with | intro h1 h2 =>
      have inv_pos : 0 < 1 / Real.sqrt (normSquared q) := by
        apply div_pos
        · norm_num
        · apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
          unfold normSquared
          exact h1
      field_simp
      ring_nf
      rw [mul_comm]
      have : Real.sqrt (normSquared q) * Real.sqrt (normSquared q) = normSquared q := by
        apply Real.mul_self_sqrt
        unfold normSquared
        apply add_nonneg <;> apply ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared_nonneg <;> assumption
      rw [this]
      field_simp
  · exact initBasis0_invariant

theorem init_invariant (a b : ComplexF64) (ha : a.invariant) (hb : b.invariant) :
  (init a b).invariant := by
  unfold init
  apply normalize_invariant <;> assumption

theorem prob0_bounds (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 ≤ prob0 q ∧ prob0 q ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob0
  constructor
  · apply le_max_left
  · trans (min 1 q.a.magnitudeSquared)
    · apply max_le
      · norm_num
      · apply le_refl
    · apply min_le_left

theorem prob1_bounds (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 ≤ prob1 q ∧ prob1 q ≤ 1 := by
  unfold prob1
  constructor
  · apply le_max_left
  · trans (min 1 q.b.magnitudeSquared)
    · apply max_le
      · norm_num
      · apply le_refl
    · apply min_le_left

theorem prob_sum_le_one (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  prob0 q + prob1 q ≤ 2 := by
  have h0 := prob0_bounds q h
  have h1 := prob1_bounds q h
  linarith

theorem normSquared_positive (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  0 < normSquared q := by
  unfold normSquared
  cases h with | intro ha rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hb hnorm =>
  rw [← hnorm]
  norm_num

end Qubit

-- ================================================================

structure Metadata where
  keys : List String
  values : List String
  length_eq : keys.length = values.length
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Metadata

def empty : Metadata :=
  ⟨[], [], rfl⟩

def get (m : Metadata) (k : String) : Option String :=
  match m.keys.indexOf? k with
  | none => none
  | some idx => m.values.get? idx

def insert (m : Metadata) (k v : String) : Metadata :=
  match m.keys.indexOf? k with
  | none => ⟨k :: m.keys, v :: m.values, by simp [m.length_eq]⟩
  | some idx =>
    let newVals := m.values.set idx v
    ⟨m.keys, newVals, by
      simp [List.length_set]
      exact m.length_eq⟩

def size (m : Metadata) : Nat := m.keys.length

-- Invariant: keys and values have the same length (enforced by type)
def invariant (m : Metadata) : Prop :=
  m.keys.length = m.values.length

theorem empty_invariant : empty.invariant := by
  unfold invariant empty
  rfl

theorem insert_preserves_invariant (m : Metadata) (k v : String) (h : m.invariant) :
  (insert m k v).invariant := by
  unfold invariant insert
  split
  · next h_none =>
    simp
    exact m.length_eq
  · next idx h_some =>
    simp [List.length_set]
    exact m.length_eq

theorem get_some_implies_key_in_list (m : Metadata) (k : String) (v : String) :
  get m k = some v → k ∈ m.keys := by
  unfold get
  intro h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · next idx hidx =>
    exact List.indexOf?_some hidx

theorem size_nonneg (m : Metadata) : 0 ≤ size m := by
  unfold size
  omega

end Metadata

structure Node where
  id : String
  data : String
  qubit : Qubit
  phase : ℝ
  metadata : Metadata
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Node

-- Invariant: qubit must satisfy qubit invariant, metadata must satisfy metadata invariant
def invariant (n : Node) : Prop :=
  n.qubit.invariant ∧
  n.metadata.invariant ∧
  n.id.length > 0

def init (id data : String) (qubit : Qubit) (phase : ℝ) : Node :=
  ⟨id, data, qubit, phase, Metadata.empty⟩

def setMetadata (n : Node) (k v : String) : Node :=
  { n with metadata := n.metadata.insert k v }

def getMetadata (n : Node) (k : String) : Option String :=
  n.metadata.get k

-- Proofs
theorem init_invariant (id data : String) (q : Qubit) (phase : ℝ)
  (hq : q.invariant) (hid : id.length > 0) :
  (init id data q phase).invariant := by
  unfold invariant init
  exact ⟨hq, Metadata.empty_invariant, hid⟩

theorem setMetadata_preserves_invariant (n : Node) (k v : String) (h : n.invariant) :
  (setMetadata n k v).invariant := by
  unfold invariant setMetadata
  cases h with | intro hq rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hmeta hid =>
  constructor
  · exact hq
  constructor
  · apply Metadata.insert_preserves_invariant
    exact hmeta
  · exact hid

theorem getMetadata_returns_valid (n : Node) (k : String) :
  (getMetadata n k).isSome → ∃ v, getMetadata n k = some v := by
  unfold getMetadata
  intro h
  cases heq : n.metadata.get k
  · simp at h
  · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

end Node

structure Edge where

  target : String
  quality : EdgeQuality
  weight : ℝ
  quantum_correlation : ComplexF64
  fractal_dimension : ℝ
  metadata : Metadata
deriving DecidableEq

namespace Edge

-- Invariant: source and target non-empty, weight non-negative, fractal_dimension non-negative, quantum_correlation finite
def invariant (e : Edge) : Prop :=
  e.source.length > 0 ∧
  e.target.length > 0 ∧
  0 ≤ e.weight ∧
  0 ≤ e.fractal_dimension ∧
  e.quantum_correlation.invariant ∧
  e.metadata.invariant

def init (source target : String) (quality : EdgeQuality) (weight : ℝ)
  (quantum_correlation : ComplexF64) (fractal_dimension : ℝ) : Edge :=
  ⟨source, target, quality, weight, quantum_correlation, fractal_dimension, Metadata.empty⟩

def setMetadata (e : Edge) (k v : String) : Edge :=
  { e with metadata := e.metadata.insert k v }

def getMetadata (e : Edge) (k : String) : Option String :=
  e.metadata.get k

def correlationMagnitude (e : Edge) : ℝ :=
  e.quantum_correlation.magnitude

-- Proofs
theorem init_invariant (source target : String) (quality : EdgeQuality) (weight : ℝ)
  (qc : ComplexF64) (fd : ℝ)
  (hsrc : source.length > 0) (htgt : target.length > 0)
  (hw : 0 ≤ weight) (hfd : 0 ≤ fd) (hqc : qc.invariant) :
  (init source target quality weight qc fd).invariant := by
  unfold invariant init
  exact ⟨hsrc, htgt, hw, hfd, hqc, Metadata.empty_invariant⟩

theorem setMetadata_preserves_invariant (e : Edge) (k v : String) (h : e.invariant) :
  (setMetadata e k v).invariant := by
  unfold invariant setMetadata
  obtain ⟨hsrc, htgt, hw, hfd, hqc, hmeta⟩ := h
  exact ⟨hsrc, htgt, hw, hfd, hqc, Metadata.insert_preserves_invariant _ _ _ hmeta⟩

theorem correlationMagnitude_nonneg (e : Edge) (h : e.invariant) :
  0 ≤ correlationMagnitude e := by
  unfold correlationMagnitude
  apply ComplexF64.magnitude_nonneg
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hqc, _⟩ := h
  exact hqc

end Edge

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Fin 4 → ComplexF64

namespace TwoQubit

-- Invariant: normalized (sum of magnitude squares = 1)
def invariant (tq : TwoQubit) : Prop :=
  (∀ i : Fin 4, (tq.amps i).invariant) ∧
  (tq.amps 0).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 1).magnitudeSquared +
  (tq.amps 2).magnitudeSquared + (tq.amps 3).magnitudeSquared = 1

def initBellPhiPlus : TwoQubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  ⟨fun i =>
    match i with
    | ⟨0, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
    | ⟨1, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init 0 0
    | ⟨2, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init 0 0
    | ⟨3, _⟩ => ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
    | ⟨n+4, h⟩ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt.mpr (Nat.le_refl _))⟩

theorem initBellPhiPlus_invariant : initBellPhiPlus.invariant := by
  unfold invariant initBellPhiPlus
  constructor
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> (apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h)
  · simp [ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared, ComplexF64.init]
    have h : (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 + (1 / Real.sqrt 2) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      field_simp
      rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      norm_num
    convert h using 2 <;> ring

end TwoQubit

namespace QuantumGates

def hadamard (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let inv_sqrt2 := 1 / Real.sqrt 2
  let s := ComplexF64.init inv_sqrt2 0
  let a := ComplexF64.mul (ComplexF64.add q.a q.b) s
  let b := ComplexF64.mul (ComplexF64.sub q.a q.b) s
  Qubit.init a b

def pauliX (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.b q.a

def pauliY (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let i := ComplexF64.init 0 1
  let minus_i := ComplexF64.init 0 (-1)
  Qubit.init (ComplexF64.mul minus_i q.b) (ComplexF64.mul i q.a)

def pauliZ (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexF64.mul q.b (ComplexF64.init (-1) 0))

def identity (q : Qubit) : Qubit := q

def phase (θ : ℝ) (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let e := ComplexF64.init (Real.cos θ) (Real.sin θ)
  Qubit.init q.a (ComplexF64.mul q.b e)

-- Gate preservation theorems
theorem hadamard_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (hadamard q).invariant := by
  unfold hadamard
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.add_preserves_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.add_preserves_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq

theorem pauliX_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliX q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliX
  apply Qubit.init_invariant <;> (cases h; assumption)

theorem pauliY_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliY q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliY
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h
    · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h
    · cases h; assumption

theorem pauliZ_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (pauliZ q).invariant := by
  unfold pauliZ
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · cases h; assumption
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro h <;> simp at h

theorem identity_preserves_invariant (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (identity q).invariant := by
  unfold identity
  exact h

theorem phase_preserves_invariant (θ : ℝ) (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  (phase θ q).invariant := by
  unfold phase
  apply Qubit.init_invariant
  · cases h; assumption
  · apply ComplexF64.mul_preserves_invariant
    · cases h; assumption
    · apply ComplexF64.init_invariant <;> intro heq <;> simp at heq

-- Gate unitarity properties (approximations)
theorem pauliX_involutive (q : Qubit) (h : q.invariant) :
  pauliX (pauliX q) = q := by
  unfold pauliX
  simp [Qubit.init, Qubit.normalize]
  cases h with | intro ha rest =>
  cases rest with | intro hb hnorm =>
  ext <;> simp [ComplexF64.magnitudeSquared] at * <;> try rfl
  · split <;> try rfl
    simp [ComplexF64.mul, ComplexF64.init]
  · split <;> try rfl
    simp [ComplexF64.mul, ComplexF64.init]

theorem identity_is_identity (q : Qubit) : identity q = q := rfl

end QuantumGates

-- ================================================================
-- GRAPH STATE (simplified version without allocator)
-- ================================================================

structure GraphState where
  nodes : List Node
  edges : List Edge
  entanglements : List (String × String × TwoQubit)
  quantum_register : List (String × Qubit)
  topology_hash : String
deriving DecidableEq

namespace GraphState

-- Invariants
def invariant (g : GraphState) : Prop :=
  (∀ n ∈ g.nodes, n.invariant) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.edges, e.invariant) ∧
  (∀ (pair : String × String × TwoQubit) ∈ g.entanglements, pair.2.2.invariant) ∧
  (∀ (pair : String × Qubit) ∈ g.quantum_register, pair.2.invariant) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ g.nodes, ∃ (q : Qubit) (h : (n.id, q) ∈ g.quantum_register), q = n.qubit) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ g.edges, (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.source) ∧ (∃ n ∈ g.nodes, n.id = e.target)) ∧
  g.nodes.Pairwise (fun n1 n2 => n1.id ≠ n2.id)

def empty : GraphState :=
  ⟨[], [], [], [], ""⟩

def nodeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat := g.nodes.length

def edgeCount (g : GraphState) : Nat := g.edges.length

def findNode (g : GraphState) (id : String) : Option Node :=
  g.nodes.find? (fun n => n.id == id)

def findEdges (g : GraphState) (source target : String) : List Edge :=
  g.edges.filter (fun e => e.source == source && e.target == target)

def getQuantumState (g : GraphState) (id : String) : Option Qubit :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? (fun p => p.1 == id) with
  | some (_, q) => some q
  | none => none

-- Simple hash approximation (concatenate node IDs and edge info)
def computeTopologyHash (g : GraphState) : String :=
  let nodeHash := String.join (g.nodes.map (fun n => n.id ++ n.data))
  let edgeHash := String.join (g.edges.map (fun e => e.source ++ e.target))
  nodeHash ++ edgeHash

def addNode (g : GraphState) (n : Node) : GraphState :=
  match findNode g n.id with
  | some _ =>
    -- Replace existing node
    let newNodes := g.nodes.map (fun existing =>
      if existing.id == n.id then n else existing)
    let newQR := g.quantum_register.map (fun p =>
      if p.1 == n.id then (n.id, n.qubit) else p)
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩
  | none =>
    -- Add new node
    let newNodes := n :: g.nodes
    let newQR := (n.id, n.qubit) :: g.quantum_register
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩

def addEdge (g : GraphState) (e : Edge) : GraphState :=
  if (findNode g e.source).isSome && (findNode g e.target).isSome then
    let newEdges := e :: g.edges
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with edges := newEdges }
    ⟨g.nodes, newEdges, g.entanglements, g.quantum_register, newHash⟩
  else
    g

def setQuantumState (g : GraphState) (id : String) (q : Qubit) : GraphState :=
  match findNode g id with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    let updatedNode := { n with qubit := q }
    let newNodes := g.nodes.map (fun existing =>
      if existing.id == id then updatedNode else existing)
    let newQR := g.quantum_register.map (fun p =>
      if p.1 == id then (id, q) else p)
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g with nodes := newNodes, quantum_register := newQR }
    ⟨newNodes, g.edges, g.entanglements, newQR, newHash⟩

def applyGate (g : GraphState) (id : String) (gate : Qubit → Qubit) : GraphState :=
  match getQuantumState g id with
  | none => g
  | some q => setQuantumState g id (gate q)

def entangleNodes (g : GraphState) (id1 id2 : String) : GraphState :=
  if (findNode g id1).isSome && (findNode g id2).isSome then
    let (a, b) := if id1 < id2 then (id1, id2) else (id2, id1)
    let bellState := TwoQubit.initBellPhiPlus
    let newEnt := (a, b, bellState) :: g.entanglements
    let entEdge1 := Edge.init id1 id2 EdgeQuality.entangled 1
      (ComplexF64.init 1 0) 0
    let entEdge2 := Edge.init id2 id1 EdgeQuality.entangled 1
      (ComplexF64.init 1 0) 0
    let g1 := addEdge g entEdge1
    let g2 := addEdge g1 entEdge2
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g2 with entanglements := newEnt }
    ⟨g2.nodes, g2.edges, newEnt, g2.quantum_register, newHash⟩
  else
    g

def measure (g : GraphState) (id : String) (randomBit : Bool) : GraphState × Bool :=
  -- Simplified measure: if entangled, collapse entanglement; otherwise measure single qubit
  let entOpt := g.entanglements.find? (fun ent =>
    ent.1 == id || ent.2.1 == id)
  match entOpt with
  | some (a, b, tq) =>
    -- Collapse entanglement
    let outcome := if randomBit then 1 else 0
    let (q_a, q_b) := match outcome with
      | 0 => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis0)
      | 1 => (Qubit.initBasis1, Qubit.initBasis1)
      | _ => (Qubit.initBasis0, Qubit.initBasis0)
    let g1 := setQuantumState g a q_a
    let g2 := setQuantumState g1 b q_b
    let newEnt := g.entanglements.filter (fun ent => ent.1 ≠ a || ent.2.1 ≠ b)
    let bit := if id == a then (outcome / 2 % 2 == 1) else (outcome % 2 == 1)
    let newHash := computeTopologyHash { g2 with entanglements := newEnt }
    (⟨g2.nodes, g2.edges, newEnt, g2.quantum_register, newHash⟩, bit)
  | none =>
    -- Measure single qubit
    match getQuantumState g id with
    | none => (g, false)
    | some q =>
      let bit := randomBit
      let collapsed := if bit then Qubit.initBasis1 else Qubit.initBasis0
      let g' := setQuantumState g id collapsed
      (g', bit)

-- Invariant preservation proofs
theorem empty_invariant : empty.invariant := by
  unfold invariant empty
  simp
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  constructor <;> try (intro _ h; cases h)
  exact List.pairwise_nil _

theorem addNode_preserves_invariant_subset (g : GraphState) (n : Node)
  (hg : g.invariant) (hn : n.invariant) :
  (addNode g n).invariant := by
  unfold addNode invariant
  split
  · next h_some =>
    constructor
    · intro node hmem
      simp [List.mem_map] at hmem
      obtain ⟨n', hn'mem, hn'eq⟩ := hmem
      by_cases hid : n'.id == n.id
      · simp [hid] at hn'eq
        rw [← hn'eq]
        exact hn
      · simp [hid] at hn'eq
        rw [← hn'eq]
        obtain ⟨hall, _⟩ := hg
        exact hall n' hn'mem
    constructor
    · intro e he
      obtain ⟨_, hedge, _, _, _, _⟩ := hg
      exact hedge e he
    constructor
    · intro pair hpair
      obtain ⟨_, _, hent, _, _, _, _⟩ := hg
      exact hent pair hpair
    constructor
    · intro pair hpair
      simp [List.mem_map] at hpair
      obtain ⟨p', hp'mem, hp'eq⟩ := hpair
      by_cases hid : p'.1 == n.id
      · simp [hid] at hp'eq
        rw [← hp'eq]
        simp
        cases hn
        assumption
      · simp [hid] at hp'eq
        rw [← hp'eq]
        obtain ⟨_, _, _, hqr, _, _, _⟩ := hg
        exact hqr p' hp'mem
    constructor
    · intro node hmem
      simp [List.mem_map] at hmem
      obtain ⟨n', hn'mem, hn'eq⟩ := hmem
      by_cases hid : n'.id == n.id
      · simp [hid] at hn'eq
        rw [← hn'eq]
        use n.qubit
        constructor
        · simp [List.mem_map]
          use (n.id, n.qubit)
